preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The lengths of strings A and B are between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of favorite strings is between 1 and 10000, inclusive.
The length of each favorite string is between 1 and 26, inclusive.
The beauty of each favorite string is between 1 and 100000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: A, B, S_1, S_2, ..., S_N contain only lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: Both A and B, as well as all favorite strings, contain only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: S_1, S_2, ..., S_N are pairwise distinct
preconditions.description: All favorite strings are pairwise distinct.

preconditions.expression: the sum of |A| over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^3
preconditions.description: The total length of all strings A across all test cases does not exceed 2000.

preconditions.expression: the sum of |B| over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^3
preconditions.description: The total length of all strings B across all test cases does not exceed 2000.

preconditions.expression: the sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^4
preconditions.description: The total number of favorite strings across all test cases does not exceed 20000.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a single integer representing the maximum pleasure Chef can get from a string he buys in the shop.
